wnba.Description: — Marine Johannes scored a career-high 27 points, hitting seven 3-pointers, and the New York Liberty routed the short-handed Las Vegas Aces 111-71 on Sunday.

wnba.Headline: Aces rest Wilson, Gray, Young in 40-point loss to Liberty
wnba.Description: Without A'ja Wilson, Chelsea Gray and Jackie Young, the Las Vegas Aces were no match for the New York Liberty at Barclays Center, losing 111-71 on Sunday, a result that matched the second-largest loss in franchise history, according to ESPN Research.
